# entrepot_role (Resource)

A custom role: a named set of actions that `entrepot_role_binding` grants to users, groups, GitLab trust policies or all authenticated principals on matching repositories.

The built-in roles (`viewer`, `developer`, `maintainer`, `admin`) are read-only and cannot be managed with this resource; reference them by name in role bindings (or read them with the `entrepot_role` data source).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom role for CI jobs that publish packages but never delete them.
resource "entrepot_role" "publisher" {
  name        = "publisher"
  description = "Read and upload packages"
  actions     = ["read", "write"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions the role grants: any of `read`, `write` (upload/overwrite), `delete` and `admin` (manage the repository; on repository pattern `*` it grants system administration).
- `name` (String) Role name. Must not be a built-in role name. Changing it forces a new role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Custom roles are imported by name (built-in roles cannot be managed).
terraform import entrepot_role.publisher publisher
```
